item.title: 49ers' Brock Purdy, other NFL stars coach young Bay Area athletes in flag football game
item.description: The Super Bowl Experience festivities continued Wednesday night at San Francisco's Moscone Center, where some of the NFL's biggest players took on a new coaching role. Young athletes, NFL stars team up on the field49ers quarterback Brock Purdy was among the stars mentoring female flag football players from Bay Area high schools, in a special game. "We just kept the energy up. We were dancing through the entire game," said Riley Harrington, an athlete from Amador Valley High School in Pleasanton.

item.title: Chinatown's 'Big Game Block Party' ahead of Super Bowl and Chinese New Year

item.title: San Francisco teachers will strike Monday if demands not met
item.description: A potentially historic teachers’ strike is looming in San Francisco as contract negotiations between educators and the San Francisco Unified School District remain at an impasse, with pay and health care benefits still unresolved.The teachers union on Thursday said they will strike Monday if their demands are not met. item.title: Teen charged with murder in SF triple shooting that left girl, 15 dead
item.description: A 16-year-old boy was charged Thursday with murder and attempted murder in a shooting in San Francisco's Western Addition that left a 15-year-old girl dead. "This was a life lost far too soon," said San Francisco District Attorney Brooke Jenkins.
